summary: Iteration 28 PRIVACY & REGRESSION audit — PASS. Backend: 46/46 pytest cases pass (1 skipped — org B's /shifts/plan returned no shift_ids for a lone future planned shift, cosmetic, unrelated to auth) in /app/backend/tests/backend_iteration28_test.py. (A) Newly-protected endpoints all return 401 without a Bearer token — verified for POST /api/scan-receipt, /api/transcribe, /api/ai/ndis-assistant, /api/ai/app-help, /api/register-push, and GET /api/briefing/{investor,lean-launch,engineering,compliance}. With owner Bearer: scan-receipt & transcribe pass auth (return 500 on the stub payload as expected — spec accepted); /ai/ndis-assistant returns 200 {answer:str, codes:[...]} for 'personal care weekday evening'; /ai/app-help returns 200 {answer:str} for 'How do I create an invoice?'; /register-push passes auth (upstream is placeholder → 500, but not 401). (A2) Briefings — non-owner (TEST_DEMO_EMAIL) gets 403 for all four names; an ephemeral just-registered user also gets 403; owner (TEST_USER_EMAIL) gets 200 with content-type application/pdf and %PDF magic bytes for all four (investor, lean-launch, engineering, compliance). (B) Tenant isolation — created two ephemeral orgs A & B via /auth/register (each seeded with client + invoice + task + receipt + expense + shift-template + planned shift). Confirmed A cannot GET/PUT/DELETE B's invoice (all 404, no data leak); GET /api/invoices for A lists only A's IDs, never B's; identical isolation for /api/clients (GET, DELETE), /api/tasks (LIST, PATCH, DELETE), /api/receipts (LIST, DELETE), /api/expenses (LIST, PATCH, DELETE), /api/shift-templates (LIST, PUT, DELETE), /api/shifts (LIST). All rely on _oid_org(id, org) at server.py:266 — the tenant-key guarantee. (C) Public endpoints unchanged: /api/ (200), /api/ndis-codes (200 non-empty list), /api/ndis-catalogue (200 with items), /api/ndis-catalogue/version (200 with version), /api/billing/plans (200), /api/auth/login|forgot|logout reachable. (D) Iteration 27 regression green: POST /api/invoices with service_date='2026-01-25' stores + returns + GET confirms; PUT with service_date='2026-02-11' updates + GET confirms; PDF (GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf) contains 'Service date' label AND '11/02/2026' formatted date via pypdf extraction. Frontend (390x844, owner login): (1) login successful, dashboard renders. (2) Assistant screen (/assistant, NDIS Code Assistant) loaded — sent 'How do I create an invoice?', got a GPT-grounded reply ('I can only help with recommending NDIS support item line codes...') proving the frontend Bearer token attaches correctly for /api/ai/ndis-assistant post-auth-gating. (3) Invoices tab → new-invoice-btn → New Invoice screen with service-date-input rendered. (4) Tapped Select NDIS support item (ndis-code-btn-0-0) → Ask AI Code Assistant modal (open-ai-assistant-btn) opened, ai-msg-0 intro visible; sent '2 hours personal care weekday evening' → 1 ai-code-* chip returned (the modal called /api/ai/ndis-assistant WITH the frontend's Bearer token and succeeded — proves iteration 28's tightened auth did not regress the in-app AI flow). (5) Logout via tool-account → account-logout → login screen re-appeared → re-logged in with owner creds → dashboard shows Command/Clients/Scan/Invoices/Planner tabs again ✓. NOTE: The service-date default-today visual check was inconclusive because the DateInput on web has no plain <input> descendant and inner_text() returns '' — same tooling gap flagged in iteration 27. Backend already covers this via test_create_with_service_date persistence check. No red-screen errors, no console errors beyond pre-existing RN-Web shadow* / pointerEvents deprecation warnings and expo-notifications-web notice.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:312 scan-receipt now `Depends(current_org)` — 401 flow verified; the `_ = org` is unused inside the function body (org isn't needed since the endpoint only calls the LLM), fine for now.

server.py:447 /ai/ndis-assistant + server.py:558 /ai/app-help both `Depends(current_org)` — good; user IP is preserved without leaking the catalogue itself (catalogue GETs remain public which the user explicitly wanted).

server.py:2322 /register-push uses `Depends(get_current_user)` — correct: it forwards the caller's user_id to the push provider. Consider server-side overriding body.user_id with user['user_id'] so a malicious client can't register a device token against another user's push channel (currently the client-supplied user_id is trusted for the upstream call).

server.py:2734 /briefing/{name} — get_current_user + hard-coded owner email check ('TEST_USER_EMAIL'). Works, but consider a `is_owner` flag on the user document (or an env var OWNER_EMAILS list) so the owner identity isn't hard-coded in code. Not blocking.

server.py:266 _oid_org(id, org) — this single helper is the anchor of tenant isolation. Every /invoices, /clients, /tasks, /receipts, /expenses, /shift-templates, /shifts by-id GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE uses it — proven leak-free by 20+ cross-org tests today.
server.py:243 get_current_user — 401 branches cover missing header, invalid session, expired session, and missing user; expiration is timezone-normalised — good.
server.py:2725 BRIEFING_FILES points at /app/*.pdf; make sure these files ship with the production image (they exist on this preview container, verified by 200 PDF response).
PUBLIC catalogue endpoints (/api/ndis-codes, /api/ndis-catalogue, /api/ndis-catalogue/version) intentionally have no auth — spec-approved (government price-guide data).
No file changes needed for this iteration — the 6 auth-gate additions are already in place at the referenced lines.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 28 fully green. Backend privacy posture is now: (1) every business-data endpoint requires Bearer + is scoped by org_id via _oid_org — 20+ cross-org attempts all return 404 with no data leak; (2) 6 previously-anonymous endpoints (scan-receipt, transcribe, ai/ndis-assistant, ai/app-help, register-push, briefing/{name}) now require Bearer; (3) briefings additionally enforce owner-email check → 403 for any other user; (4) public catalogue + auth entry points still work anonymously as required. Iteration-27 service_date + AI Code Assistant flow untouched and re-verified end-to-end (backend + frontend). If future iterations add new endpoints, they MUST use `Depends(current_org)` or `Depends(get_current_user)` and (for by-id operations) `_oid_org(id, org)` — the isolation test file is designed to be extended with new resources by appending to TestTenantIsolation. Owner-email hard-coding in /briefing (server.py:2737) is the only cosmetic action item worth revisiting.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Design note only: /api/register-push trusts client-supplied body.user_id when forwarding to the push provider (server.py:2324). Suggest overriding with `user['user_id']` server-side so a caller cannot register a device token against another user's push channel — this is a defence-in-depth improvement, not a leak of app data.
